svg.title: The passage from Kyria to Synesta’s well
svg.desc: Five numbered landmarks in a cutaway of the caves. Cross the first stream for the Water Bomb, then return to the shallows and follow them upstream. Jump the deep pool by its stepping stone. At the dry fork the north spur holds Ammonia; the south tunnel leads to flooded steps. The 500-zenny chest is on a side ledge across a gap. Return to the steps and climb to the upper tunnel and the ladder beneath Synesta’s well.
svg.metadata: Original editorial illustration by BoF Atelier contributors, 2026. CC BY 4.0. Hand-authored SVG paths, assisted by OpenAI Codex, in the BoF Atelier Chrysm atlas style. Geographical relationships informed by Dalez (section I.L), RealXaenith (Synesta Pathway), Billy Lee (Passage to Synesta) and the game's local Lab observations. No game graphics, captured layouts or third-party illustrations are reproduced. The companion WebP is a lossless rendering of this drawing.
